note: STING worked example (engine-doctrine/EVALS.md, skills/vawe-type/reference/sting.md). One move, the mark, six seconds: Halyard's eye-splice mark, a taut line ending in a spliced loop, draws itself on stroke by stroke and holds as an outline (a closed loop filled solid would drop the line, which has no area of its own), and the wordmark settles in behind it. No cuts, no second beat: `BLACK MEANS #000000` (AGENTS.md) since the brief calls for a true black bumper. Theme mercury.

_why.no-storyboard: a fixed eval fixture (engine-doctrine/EVALS.md): liveness proof for `make gen X=evals`, not a planned film with a requester to sign a lock sheet
_why.no-preflight: same fixture: the 9-step decision chain precedes a real brief, this file's brief is fixed and re-run unchanged on every doctrine change
_why.craft-unvisited: same fixture: it exists to stay small and pass validate/liveness, not to carry a full make dev-tool X=preflight craft pass
_why.static-bg: true black is the brief: BLACK MEANS #000000, a lit or moving field would be a tinted bumper, not this one
_why.no-transition: one move, the mark, no second beat: this note already says so, a cut would be a second beat this sting deliberately does not have

audio._why: a sting's one cue is a real sound decision this fixture defers: it exists to stay small and prove liveness, not to make an audio choice
